verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Devin's ability to work with GitHub repos (e.g. querying repo docs with authentication) and various integration modes (Slack, IDE, API, MCP) but never documents a one-click GitHub App install or simplified repo-connection onboarding flow; setup steps like authentication are implied but not detailed as low-friction. missing for 10: explicit one-click GitHub App/OAuth install flow, screenshots or docs of the repo-connection onboarding UX, confirmation that setup requires no manual configuration.
